files.notes: name + textdomain swapped; adds the `language` attribute (#1044).

TypeScript port; adds the language select (#1044). Enter exits on a double Enter via `_shared/use-exit-on-double-enter` instead of upstream's triple Enter (`__unstableOnSplitAtDoubleLineEnd`) (#1101).
TypeScript port; verbatim escape() handling; prints `language-*` on the code element when a language is set (#1044).
No upstream deprecation chain; empty array preserves the file shape across forks.
Upstream raw/input/block transforms preserved; added bidirectional core/code ↔ artisanpack/code + accepts artisanpack/paragraph.
TypeScript port; dropped @wordpress/compose `pipe` dependency in favor of direct composition.
Adapted to the visual-editor auto-discovery contract.

knownDivergences: Enter exits on a double Enter (`_shared/use-exit-on-double-enter`) instead of upstream's triple Enter, so a trailing blank line can't be typed at the end of the block (#1101).
utils.ts inlines the upstream `pipe` composition rather than depending on `@wordpress/compose.pipe`.
transforms.ts adds bidirectional block transforms with core/code.
The `language` attribute and its `language-*` class have no upstream equivalent (#1044). Blocks with no language still save byte-equivalent to upstream.
